```python
for cid in car_ids:
    out = await run_command(f"cd skills/state-travel && python cli.py call get_car_rental --args '{{\"rental_id\":\"{cid}\"}}'")

    parsed = json.loads(raw.split('\n(.venv)', 1)[0].strip())
    print(f"\n=== {dtype.upper()} - {did} ===")
    print(json.dumps(parsed["result"], indent=2))
```
